title: Carry identity badges (agora_credentials leaf extension)
description: Decided by Mark 2026-10-17 (see memory agora-credentials). Implement after the MLS-SoT batch commits: LeafNode extension (next private-use code after 0xF0A4), TLS struct list of {media_type, bytes}; subject DID must equal leaf DID; KeyPackage omission by default with opt-in; verification and issuer trust are client policy; §4.6.3 accepted-sender rules and Space admission may use verified credentials; §12 privacy note; Appendix D registry; profiles note (employer EmployeeCredential).
